verdict.rationale: Isaac covers the separate pieces: Isaac Sim ingests real-world captures (NuRec, TeleOp) and supports custom data pipelines that complement existing data sources, Isaac Lab and GR00T train policies, and Isaac ROS deploys onto Jetson embedded systems. Nothing shows these pieces joined into a loop that takes fleet-collected data into training and pushes the retrained model back to deployed robots. Missing for 10: an end-to-end data-to-training-to-fleet workflow, fleet-level model rollout or OTA updates, ingestion of logged operational fleet data for retraining, and independent hands-on corroboration.
